verdict.rationale: LegalOS's own pages cover O-1, H-1B (including transfers, extensions and a startup-sponsorship guide), TN, and the EB-1A and EB-2 NIW green-card paths. It also offers path-selection guidance through an O-1 eligibility checker and its claim to help startups 'identify the right visa or green card path'. However, E-2 never appears in the evidence, and nothing addresses cap-exempt H-1B routes. Missing for 10: E-2 treaty-investor coverage, cap-exempt H-1B guidance, an explicit comparative decision guide across visa types, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the provider's own materials cover the full startup visa menu — O-1, H-1B (including cap-exempt routes), E-2, TN, and the green-card paths — with guidance on choosing the right one for my situation
